create_nested_dictionary_dataset: create a NestedDictionaryDataset from a nested dict of FairseqDataset instances with matching lengths
flatten_nested_dict: use _flatten to recursively flatten a nested dictionary into dot-separated key paths
unflatten_dict: use _unflatten to reconstruct a nested dictionary from flattened dot-separated key paths
collate_samples: call collater on a NestedDictionaryDataset to merge a list of samples into a mini-batch
prefetch_dataset_indices: call prefetch on a NestedDictionaryDataset to pre-load data for given sample indices
